craft_evidence.owned: none evidenced: the supply-chain page says manufacturing and sourcing management was brought back in-house in 2019 with teams in London and Milan, and that 10 direct manufacturing suppliers, 31 sub-suppliers and 2 warehouses were audited in 2025 (external suppliers, unnamed); no owned factory named
craft_evidence.makers: none on product pages (70 men's clothing PDPs read); craftsmanship pages name partners for non-menswear goods (Ethical Fashion Initiative, Made in Kenya bags; John Amathus)
craft_evidence.mills: on brand pages, not PDPs: Lochcarron of Scotland (tartan, 'for over three decades') and Harris Tweed (first used AW1987/88); PDPs name tartan setts (Buchanan, Fraser) but not the mill
craft_evidence.madein: 32/70 men's clothing PDPs state 'Made in Italy' in the details list (mostly knitwear, trousers, jackets); 38/70 state no country, including all shirts except one and all printed T-shirts but one
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed: 'Established in 1971, 430 Kings Road is where Vivienne and Malcolm McLaren first showcased their ideas' (Worlds End page); shop renamed Worlds End in 1980
craft_evidence.process: partial: PDP copy cites 'Vivienne's original tailoring system' and 'experimental pattern-cutting techniques' (Krall, Chaos shirts); Worlds End collection made from leftover production fabrics; Harris Tweed handwoven on Outer Hebrides (mill's process, not the house's)
craft_evidence.reasoning: Vivienne Westwood owns no factory it names; its supply-chain page describes in-house sourcing management since 2019 and audited external suppliers. What it does name are two textile sources with dates, Lochcarron of Scotland for tartan (over three decades) and Harris Tweed (since AW1987/88), and 32 of 70 men's PDPs state Made in Italy. Named mills plus a dated, placed heritage (430 King's Road, 1971) and nothing owned reads as a 3; low-to-medium confidence, since the mills are named on brand pages, not on product pages.

ownership.owner: private: Vivienne Westwood Limited (UK company 02682271, inc. 1992). Companies House lists one active person with significant control, Andreas Kronthaler (25-50% of shares and votes, notified 6 Apr 2016); Vivienne Isabel Westwood's 25-50% PSC entry ceased 29 Dec 2022. No other PSC above 25% is listed; the holder of the remainder (e.g. her estate or heirs) is not stated there
